#/texts/4.label: paragraph

The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from the 9th January,
2004 :-

#/texts/5.label: paragraph

#/texts/6.label: paragraph

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text:
iii) Kum. Mamata Banerjee assumed the charge of the office of Minister of
Coal and Mines;

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text:
iv) Shri Ramesh Bais relinquished the charge of the office of Minister of
State (Independent charge) in the Ministry of Mines and assumed the
charge of the office of Minister of State (Independent charge) in the
Ministry of Environment and Forests; and

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text:
v) Dr. Vallabhbhai Ramjibhai Kathiria relinquished the charge of the office
of Minister of State in the Ministry of Human Resource Development
and assumed the charge of the office of Minister of State in the
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
